12129.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge 1 mile south of Crawfordville has caught 57.64 inches. October is the wettest month so far at 11.09 inches. The biggest rain came Mar 17 at 3.93 inches. On the days both years reported, this year is running 11.09 inches more than 2025.

12131.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge north-northwest of De Funiak Springs has caught 67.08 inches. June was the wettest month at 14.46 inches, and the biggest single day came late, 6.44 inches on Oct 10. The longest dry stretch ran 15 days, Mar 17 to Mar 31. On the days both years reported, that is 16.96 inches more than last year.

12133.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge 10.6 miles west-southwest of Vernon has caught 59.54 inches, 5.84 more than a usual year. May was the wettest month at 11.69 inches, and the biggest single day came late, 4.56 inches on Oct 10. Before all that, the gauge sat empty 19 days in a row from Mar 18 to Apr 5. On the days both years reported, this year is 5.75 inches ahead of last year.
